# Changelog

## 1.0.0

- Initial Thunderstore release.
- Sells eligible inventory catches and freshly held items with F8.
- Optionally sells nearby dead floor fish.
- Adds native Gameplay settings for inventory and floor-fish selling.
- Protects quest items, zero-value items, living creatures, and items already being sold.
- Uses the game's normal money-NPC sale and item-destruction flow.
